full_text:
Article 3 (Notification of Decision on Investigation by a Special Prosecutor)
(1) Where the Minister of Justice decides that a special prosecutor shall conduct an investigation pursuant to Article 2 (1) 2 of the Act, the Minister shall notify the Speaker of the National Assembly thereof without delay.
(2) The notification under paragraph (1) shall be made in writing, specifically identifying and stating the matters set forth in the subparagraphs of Article 2.
